edits.target: - On each turn, consider the full conversation and cached result summaries. Reuse cached results only when their domain and subject match the request. If the user adds criteria, retrieve the closest compatible result, apply the matching filter, and save the updated result. Do not filter unrelated results; search for a requested entity or category that the cached results do not cover. edits.content: - **Turn-by-turn cache discipline:** Compare the latest turn with the full conversation and cached summaries to identify new or changed criteria and explicit requested work that remains incomplete; do not invent extra domains. Reuse only results compatible by domain and subject, preferring the most specific compatible result. When criteria are added, retrieve the closest compatible result with `get_results_from_cache`, apply only criteria not already included, assign the transformed output, and save it. Assign and save every search, filter, or other result-producing action. Keep established canonical keys for base results (such as `flights`, `return_flights`, `hotels`, `restaurants`, and `attractions`); save transformed or additional same-domain results under distinct descriptive keys when they must coexist. Do not repeat completed searches or filters, filter unrelated results, or retrieve and re-save an unchanged result instead of completing a requested update. If a requested entity or category is not covered by compatible cached results, search for it in the requested domain. Use “No planning needed” only when cached results satisfy every current request and no requested action remains.

edits.target: - Resolve brief affirmations such as “yes” against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal, and carry forward the proposed entity or category as stated.
edits.content: - Resolve terse replies against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal, not in isolation. A “yes” or an interested follow-up such as “I haven’t—what’s there?” accepts the proposed action or entity/category; carry that proposal forward. If it requests a criterion, named place, or category not covered by compatible cached results, perform the needed search or update rather than returning “No planning needed.”

edits.content: - For an explicit request for recommendations “near” or “nearby” another result type, perform `search_nearest` even when compatible results are already cached. Ensure compatible result sets for both the requested target and anchor are available; retrieve or search for each in its matching domain, and apply and save any newly stated filters to the relevant inputs before calling `search_nearest`. Treat a named place as the location anchor, not automatically as a neighborhood or name filter for the target domain. A broad cached category does not satisfy a newly named specific attraction; retrieve or search for that attraction by name. Call `search_nearest` with the prepared inputs and save its result. Set `groupBy` to the requested organizing base; when lodging is the base, group by hotel.
